sections.brief: Law of Return (1950, 1970 grandchild clause) and Nationality Law 1952 (citizenship by return, birth to a citizen parent, discretionary naturalisation) vs US Fourteenth Amendment and naturalisation (5/3 years LPR, English, civics); Trump v. Barbara (30 June 2026) upholding birthright citizenship against EO 14160; immigrants to Israel 1949-2025 (199,516 in 1990, 74,400 in 2022, 22,522 in 2025) vs US naturalisations by decade to FY2023 (878,460); exclusions: 2003/2022 family-unification ban, East Jerusalem residents (5-10% naturalised), 2023 revocation law first used Feb 2026; US unauthorised 14m (2023). Figures: compare x2

Israel's African asylum seekers (64,000 entries 2006-13, peak ~60,000, ~25,000 in 2025), Prevention of Infiltration Law amendments and the 2013/2014 rulings, Holot 2013-2018, recognition <1%, 2018 Rwanda/Uganda plan and the cancelled UNHCR deal; US refugee ceilings 231,700 (1980) to 7,500/17,500 (FY2026), court backlog 3.8m, border asylum closure struck by D.C. Circuit (24 April 2026), DHS removals 1980-2022 and ICE ~320,000 (FY2025), ICE detention peak 68,289 and the July 2025 $170bn enforcement funding. Figures: time; compare
